Motion Studio / Interaction update / 11 November 2026

Continue with
one press.

All four games and the rig pointer practice keep a clear Resume action with their paused play surface. Click, tap or use the focused Enter/Space action to continue the current round.

Issue #53 · Focused PR and hosted checks

5play surfaces19 / 19browser cases passed48pxminimum observed button height

What changed and why

Resume was below the play area in the arcade and runner, outside separate game displays, and absent from the inline maze participant preview. The action now sits directly on the paused screen. The menu hides decorative art where necessary to make room at 320px without adding a confirmation or reopening setup.

  • The available Resume button receives focus once. Later keyboard navigation is respected, and play regains focus after continuation.
  • The shared controller uses the button’s current document after a window transfer. Native pointer, touch, Enter and Space activation cannot also aim, flick, push or jump; Tab and the window’s Escape action retain their normal behavior.
  • One press in Slap a Mole, Dodgeball or Runner records continuation intent. Fresh same-owner input, stable tracking/standing and the existing two-second countdown still gate simulation. Score and time remain frozen while waiting.
  • Maze preserves its input gate and explicit continuation policy. Its participant preview now resumes directly; the map stays with the operator. Rig practice keeps its selected-source and display-visibility gates and reuses the existing logical aim.

Tracking identity, source/calibration changes, hidden displays and unavailable WebGL keep their recovery requirements. A new round remains necessary when the existing ownership policy requires it. This UI update adds no camera owner, inference path or game-clock rule.

Actual verification

  • pnpm check passed: repository conventions, contracts, types, lint, 743 TypeScript tests, formatting, Python types/lint/format, 209 Python tests, rig fixture drift and byte compilation.
  • pnpm build passed: all six Vite entry points and emitted asset-reference validation.
  • English real-server Chromium 157.0.4341.42: five surfaces × 1440 × 1000, 390 × 844 and 320 × 740 viewports, plus four separate-window cases. All 19 passed with no uncaught browser errors. Camera acquisitions: zero.
  • Desktop used Enter, 390px used Space, and 320px used touch taps. Checks measured visible hit targets, verified focus, preserved the displayed score and observed gameplay continue. Minimum measured Resume size was 170 × 48px.
  • Behavior tests cover one-press intent during missing framing/standing, frozen score/time/distance while waiting, restored play focus, input-event isolation, cross-document focus, held-key suppression, Tab/Escape behavior and existing identity/visibility gates.

Local environment: Windows, Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.25.0 and Python 3.12.14. Dependencies were installed from the lockfile into this isolated worktree; Python checks reused the existing environment through a local junction. The repository pins Node 24.21.0 and Python 3.12.16 for hosted CI. Require the latest PR commit’s software-checks gate before merging; this report does not pre-claim a hosted result.

Remaining limits

Evidence is camera-free software verification in Chromium on Windows. Physical camera recovery, recognition accuracy, hardware buttons/controllers, other browser engines, varied participant bodies and end-to-end latency were not tested. Existing hardware milestone gates remain open. No participant footage, personal records or credentials appear in this report.

Reproduce with node scripts/verify-game-resume.mjs, node scripts/verify-game-resume.mjs --popups, pnpm check and pnpm build. The baseline command adds --baseline 6fb1185813242a27b26e1c86f75a2f4baa5d71f3. Regenerate this report with node scripts/game-resume-report.mjs after browser artifacts are available.

Self-contained delivery report · synthetic examples only · measurements describe UI geometry and verification counts, not performance or physical certification.
